The living room offers a separate work zone without using bedroom sleeping space or kitchen preparation space; the bathroom window is unsuitable. Inspected the desk render: restrained rectangular top, side storage and slim legs. Budget unconfirmed; 109000 AMD is catalog mock pricing, not a shop quote. Chair not included. Door swings are unknown; direct sunlight and glare have not been assessed.
